description: Links SO2 stations across the two sources: the hourly API archive (api.ust.is/aq) and the manual website downloads (10-minute where available) kept in the private bucket. Times are UTC.

fields.minutes_to_add_to_align_with_api: Add to website time stamps so that hourly means match the API's hour-ending stamps; null where no API data overlapped to check.
fields.api_minus_website_median: Median of API value minus website hourly mean (µg/m3); the API archive is baseline-corrected, the website download is not.
fields.mobile: Flagged mobile in the API or known mobile unit; the listed position may not hold for the whole record.
